Legacy campaign

Everybody Plugs In (1942–1961)

More California homes and businesses are plugging in. Halfway through your term you'll need spare power on top of what they're already using.

Open the Legacy campaign↗ Your decisions ↓

Play the chapters in order. You carry the same utility from one generation to the next.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
1942
Generation
20 years

Your starting point

You take over in 1942, sixty years after the company opened. Your starting fleet is the one the previous generation left you.

By the end of year eleven, you need spare capacity equal to 10% of the peak demand you started with. Demand grows while your crews are building.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Build ahead of the checkpoint

    Check how long each project takes. A plant that opens after year eleven won't count toward that reserve.

  2. 02

    Choose how to pay for spare capacity

    Compare the cost of adding another plant with the extra demand you expect it to serve. Your successor will inherit both the plant and the financing.

How much spare power will you have when the new customers arrive?
